versions.localizedDescription: - Icône de l'app : un refus d'iOS se voit, nouvel essai
- Pick an app icon in Settings → General → Appearance: Classic, Purple, Night, Light, Contrast or Neon, each with dark and tinted versions — “Contrast” stays sharp with iOS 26's clear icons.
- Instant live notifications, even with the app closed, through the free ntfy app (Settings → Features in testing): add the topic shown there in ntfy, and tapping a notification opens the stream.
- Multi-live on iPad: the chat of the stream you hear shows next to the mosaic (button in the mosaic, or Settings → Player).

- Downloads keep going in the background, even with the app closed; the chat can be kept and replayed offline (emotes included); a finished download can be exported as a single file (Files, AirDrop, VLC).
- Fixed a black screen on some recent VODs with muted parts (Twitch's new MP4 format); their original sound is restored too while Twitch still has it.
- Multi-live: watch up to four streams side by side. Long-press a live card (or use the player's ⋯ menu) to add it, then tap Watch in the bar at the bottom; tap a stream to hear it.

- Download a whole VOD or just a part of it (from one time to another) to watch offline, from the player's ⋯ menu. Parts muted for copyrighted music keep their original sound while Twitch still has it. Your downloads are in the My VODs tab.
- Drops: a notification when a drop is ready to claim, or when the app has claimed it for you (Settings → Drops → Notify me).
- Usage stats (if enabled) now also include the app language, iPhone or iPad, the iOS version and anonymous play counters (which source served a live, failures) — never the channels.
- Améliorations et corrections
- Drops page: a step-by-step guide to earn drops, and a live status showing whether the stream you're watching makes your drops progress.

- Drops: the Drops page now also lists every open campaign (all games) with its rewards.
- The Twitch web session must be the app's account: another account is refused at sign-in (and disconnected if found later), so points, drops and predictions never go to the wrong account.

- Drops: new Settings → Drops page with your campaigns' progress, a Claim button and automatic claiming.
- Drops now progress while you watch a live with drops (Twitch only counts them when your account loads the stream; the app does it with small requests, no extra video download).
- Spatial audio (AirPods): new setting in Settings → Player to turn it off in the app, head tracking included. “Fixed” is still picked in Control Center.

- Choose the live source (Luminous Asia, Luminous Europe, Albania proxy or official Twitch) in Settings → Player or from the player's ⋯ menu, which also shows the source in use.
- Stream tags (language, DropsEnabled…) under live streams, like on Twitch.
- Category search puts the exact match first (VALORANT for “valorant”) and shows sharp box art.
- Another ad-free source for live streams (an Albanian proxy) when Luminous is unavailable.
- Améliorations et corrections
- Live quality names stay correct when the app falls back to another ad-free mirror.
- Live streams are much closer to real time: about 6 seconds of delay instead of about 20 (Low latency mode, now on by default).

- Liquid Glass: buttons in the player (and the way back to home) work again while watching a stream.
- My reports: replies and status changes now show up on their own, no need to refresh.
- Passages coupés : plus d'avertissement de concurrence à la publication du résultat

- iPad: the back, AirPlay and close buttons at the top of the immersive player work again in landscape.
- Chat auto-sync: a more accurate delay that no longer drifts every few seconds; fine-tune it by ±1 s from the chat's ⏱ badge or in Settings.
- Themes: choose an accent color and a background (dark, OLED black, slate) in Settings > General > Appearance.
- Liquid Glass option (iOS 26): floating tab bar and glass buttons.
- Russian language, translated with AI (corrections welcome from Settings).
- VODs: parts muted by Twitch show in orange with a Skip button; on recent VODs the original sound is restored when Twitch still has it.
- Switch account button in Settings; after logging out, Twitch now asks which account to use.
- Feedback: attach screenshots, follow your reports in "My reports", read the reply and answer back; a badge shows new replies.
- The website moved to twitchunblock.vercel.app (Settings link updated).
- The bug report / idea form is now one tap away: header, Settings home and the player ⋯ menu

- New "Report a bug or suggest an idea" form in Settings
- Swiping the player down recovers if interrupted, adapts to the screen size and respects Reduce Motion
- Without an account, the app explains why lists stop at 100

- Predictions: you can now place bets (tap an outcome, pick an amount, Predict)
- Swiping the player down is now smooth and slides it away like the Twitch app
- Channel page: new "About" tab with the description, social links and panels
- Clips: 100 at once instead of 30, and "Load more" when logged in
- Links in bot command replies are now tappable
- Tapping a streamer's name on a stream card opens their channel
- Settings: option to hide recent streamers
- Pasting a Twitch link (twitch.tv/xqc) in Search opens the channel

- The Categories tab is now available without a Twitch account
- Deleted or hidden VODs now appear right among a channel's VODs, marked "Unlisted VOD" (the "Deleted" tab is gone)
- Recovered VODs that start with a muted (copyrighted) part now play
- Swipe down on the player to minimize it, like the back arrow
- Auto chat sync no longer lags 10+ s behind on channels that stream with a delay

- New interactive tutorial: a guided tour over the real screens (replay it from Settings > About)
- Home: offline followed channels now have their own "Offline" tab, next to Top streams
- Settings: new "Changelog" page listing every version and what changed
- Channel page: the "Deleted" tab now comes right after VODs
- New "Deleted" tab on a channel page: recover recently deleted VODs while Twitch still serves their segments.
- Améliorations et corrections
